g.text: Part: PPR-C10 — Traverse carriage Qty 1 Material PLA
Overall: X 90.00 Y 55.00 Z 24.00 mm; unless noted printed tolerance ±0.30 mm
Interface: 2x Ø8.4 rod bores; 2x Ø4.5 clamp bores
Fastener: 2x M4x16 belt-clamp screws; insert/nut: 2x M4 heat-set insert OD5.6 x L6 or through nyloc; tightening: 1.2 N.m
Edge distance: 8 mm from belt-pad edge; mating: donor rods and GT2 belt
Print: flat; 0.20 mm; 5 perimeters; support: rod bores only
Dimensions govern over SVG scale. Ream/fit only after printing the PPR-TC01 tolerance coupon.
